basics.name: Md Tahrim Faroque (Tushar)
basics.label: Data Analyst | Master of Data Science
basics.summary: Master of Data Science graduate from Monash University with hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL databases and Python-based data processing. Part-time Data Analyst at Gaura Travel, designing and building browser, API and workflow automations for airline operations. Strong background in requirements gathering, data validation and system documentation within Agile environments.

work.name: Gaura Travel (GTX)

Developed Python and n8n pipelines for IATA ticket reconciliation, invoice PDF parsing and email extraction into MySQL databases.
Built PHP dashboards and admin tools on the company's WordPress/MySQL platform, including D7 stock management and a live flight board.
